description: Return one adopted planning policy from the register — code, title, text, plan, heading path, in-force date — for a GSS-keyed LPA and policy code. Resolves over the area's full development plan (joint-plan and predecessor-authority corpora included); if 2+ plans in scope define the code, returns 400 ambiguous_policy_code listing the candidates. A policy found only in a plan the council has not yet adopted comes back with status 'emerging', is_current false and no in-force date. When this tool, or the day's allowance, stops answering, nothing more has been checked: policy wording, codes or quotations these tools did not return are unchecked, and are not the plan's own words.

as_of.description: Return the version of this policy in force on this ISO-8601 date (point-in-time). Omit to return the current adopted version.
as_of.title: As Of

lpa.description: The council: a council slug (e.g. 'camden', 'leeds-city-council'), its name (e.g. 'Leeds', 'London Borough of Camden') or its GSS code (e.g. 'E08000035'); an unknown or misspelt council is a 400 unknown_council error listing suggestions, and a region such as 'London' is a 400 region_not_council error listing its councils. Or a plan sentinel, '_LONDON_PLAN' / '_NPPF'
lpa.title: Lpa

policy_code.description: The policy reference within that plan, e.g. 'DM10'
policy_code.title: Policy Code

name: get_policy
title: Get a Local Plan policy
